rationale: Monotonic non-increasing Volt-VAR curve. At the low-voltage step (0.94 pu, 60 kW, 100 kVA) the curve injects q_fraction=0.143 (14.3 kvar, within the 80 kvar capability) raising voltage to 0.95001 pu. At nominal (1.0 pu, 80 kW) the curve commands zero reactive power. At the high-voltage step (1.07 pu, 60 kW) the curve absorbs q_fraction=-0.2859 (28.59 kvar, within 80 kvar) lowering voltage to 1.04999 pu. Small margins below/above the 0.95/1.05 limits guard against floating-point boundary violations, while keeping total control effort near the minimum (~42.89 kvar).
